title: SOC2 prep scratchpad - control mapping & open questions
content:
Quick scratchpad: mapping controls -> evidence -> gaps. Mostly notes to self, TODOs, open Qs. Not polished.

SUMMARY / GOAL:
- Get a lean evidence set for SOC2 Type II audit (targeting security & availability scope first).
- Draft control owners and artifacts; identify gaps we can close before evidence freeze.

CURRENT SCOPE (working):
- Services: hosted API (public endpoints), Dedicated control plane (shared infra), Private deployments (customer-managed) -> note: decide if Private on-prem customers are in-scope (likely not for standard evidence, but config guidance still required).
- Environments: prod (api-prod cluster in GCP us-west1), staging (api-staging), infra-management (control plane). Need a clear definition in Confluence (see linked page).

CONTROL MAPPING (working table, shorthand):
- CC: Access controls (user accounts, SSO, MFA) -> Owner: Noah R. -> Evidence: Okta org export, MFA policy, sample user provisioning ticket (JIRA:ID TBD), periodic access review spreadsheet (monthly).
  - TODO: confirm retention for Okta reports (how far back can we export?). Action: ask infra-team (ticket SEC-1180).
- CC: Change management / CI/CD approvals -> Owner: DevRel/Platform (Zoe K.) -> Evidence: GitHub PR reviewers, protected branches, CI logs, release notes.
  - Gap: release approval workflow not enforced for infra terraform changes (release-engineering follow-up).
- CC: Logging & Monitoring -> Owner: SRE -> Evidence: aggregated Cloud Logging views, alerting runbooks, on-call rota (PagerDuty snapshots).
  - Open: need examples of logs that show access attempts + IAM changes for a 90-day window.
- CC: Incident response -> Owner: SRE/Security -> Evidence: incident playbooks, one postmortem with timeline (recent incident: API outage 2025-09-23), SLA reports.
  - TODO: redact customer-identifying info from postmortem artifacts.
- CC: Data encryption & KMS -> Owner: Platform-Eng -> Evidence: KMS policy docs, key rotation logs, config for CSEK in Private deployments.
- CC: Vendor management -> Owner: Legal/PM -> Evidence: vendor inventory (GDrive sheet), contracts, security questionnaires (e.g., for cloud provider).

EVIDENCE TYPES WE CAN REUSE (ideas):
- Screenshots + exported CSVs from Okta / PagerDuty / Cloud console.
- GitHub PR export (PR numbers + approvals) + branch protection settings screenshot.
- Terraform Cloud run history (state changes) + RFC tickets.
- Sample onboarding checklist (HR) for new hires (access provisioning).
- Audit logs: API gateway auth logs (retention question).

OPEN QUESTIONS / RISKS (high-level):
- Private deployment scope: do we need evidence for end-customer-managed deployments? If not, need policy language clarifying responsibilities. (Confluence draft needs updating).
- Data classification: we claim 'customer PII not stored' for hosted API - but we do hold transient input data in logs for 7 days. Need to align privacy docs and retention schedules. Example: logs retention = 7 days, backups = 30 days; confirm with infra.
- Evidence retention windows: auditors often ask for 12 months. Which artifacts can we realistically export for 12mo? (Okta exports? Cloud audit logs cost to retain?).
- Role-based access: need a clear list of admin accounts and justification for SRE/Platform admin roles.

ACTION ITEMS (priority order):
1) Confirm scope decision for Private deployments by 2026-02-28. Owner: Product-Private (Samira A.). Linked: Confluence draft.
2) Access reviews: run ad-hoc Okta export for last 6 months; attach sample to SEC-1123. Owner: Noah R. Due: 2026-01-10 (missed) -> update schedule.
3) Collect 3 months of GitHub branch protection + PR approvals evidence. Owner: Zoe K. -> make a PR that collects screenshots + PR IDs. (github:451 as reference).
4) Incident evidence: prepare redacted postmortem and timeline for 2025-09-23 outage. Owner: SRE lead. Due: 2026-02-05.
5) Logging retention: confirm Cloud Logging export/backfill ability for 12 months. Owner: infra (ticket SEC-1189).

NOTES / CLIPPINGS (raw):
- Slack snippet: "@noah can you run access review?" (Slack #soc2-prep 2026-01-12) - need to capture thread link.
- Confluence draft already has control matrix but columns inconsistent with auditor template (CC1..CC8). Might reformat.
- Quick mapping suggestion: map our artifacts to common SOC2 auditor checklist from 3rd-party (AuditorX template).

UNFINISHED THOUGHTS / QUESTIONS TO ASK AUDITORS:
- If we provide customer-managed Private deployments, do auditors expect us to show patching evidence for customer infra? (Probably no, but need to confirm.)
- For ephemeral logs (7 days), is a sampling approach acceptable if we show log-forwarding config?
- Can we use screenshots + signed statements from owners for historical evidence older than retention window?

REFERENCE TICKETS / PAGES (placeholders):
- JIRA: SEC-1123 (access review collection)
- JIRA: SEC-1180 (Okta export retention question)
- Confluence: /spaces/SOC2/pages/3245 (control matrix draft)
- GitHub PR: repo/redwood-infra/pulls/451 (PR collecting branch protection screenshots)

FINAL NOTES (for next pass):
- Turn this scratchpad into a simple checklist per control with owner, required artifact, sample file name, last updated date. Then attach to Confluence.
- Keep evidence filenames consistent: soc2_evidence/<control>_<artifact>_<YYYYMMDD>. Example: soc2_evidence/access_okta_export_20260201.csv

-- end of scratchpad --
